Every branch has its own timeline but you need to request for citizenship and receive a dedicated meeting, I’m from Akko branch, I applied for renewal and citizenship separately 3 months in advance, I have received the citizenship meeting 1 month before the renewal period, during the meeting we gave the last paperwork (same center of life proof as every renewal and extra paperwork per AIC guide that Anja Hohenester-Zimmern shared in her answer). And the interview was at the same time, they didn’t renew the visa as we had 1 month validity and was told the answer will be by then. 3 weeks after and before the renewal we had the citizenship ceremony and we applied for passport at the same day. The passport will be for 1 year when you need to be most of the year in Israel in order to renew it, after the 1 year is expired you need to renew and you get for 5 years (no 10) and you need to live most of the time in Israel during these years and only after you get the regular 10 years passport. 

When you say leave while waiting for decision, did you mean for good or for a short vacation? Vacations is not a problem but for good you will might not get  your citizenship
